crossRefs.note: Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.
crossRefs.keyword: when persecuted by Saul, or driven from Jerusalem by Absalom

crossRefs.note: I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.
crossRefs.keyword: when persecuted by Saul, or driven from Jerusalem by Absalom

crossRefs.note: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.
Turn your ear, Yahweh, and hear. Open your eyes, Yahweh, and behold. Hear all of the words of Sennacherib, who has sent…
My God, turn your ear, and hear. Open your eyes, and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name…
But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.
I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
For my hand has made all these things, and so all these things came to be,” says Yahweh: “but I will look to this man…
“Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
“The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal…
But let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;
and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.
Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the…

translations.web: Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
translations.bsb: Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
translations.kjv: Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I am poor and needy.
translations.asv: Bow down thine ear, O Jehovah, and answer me; For I am poor and needy.
